cites.value: Of 13,527 labelled images from six audited harvested sources, only 3,208 come from a source that clears the 0.90 audit bar. Five of six sources fall between 0.18 and 0.74 — the probe reads 1.000 on human-labelled cwd12, so those are the data, not the instrument. Independently, the S3 tier ladder shows adding harvested data is worth 0.00-0.02. Both measurements point the same way: web harvest at this scale supplies volume, not usable supervision.
